caption:
Ep 102 of EAT LIKE A GREEK🇬🇷✨PAIDAKIA😮‍💨 follow @chefmarinie for more easy Greek recipes! 

If there’s one thing Greeks know how to do… it’s lamb 😮‍💨and these lamb chops right here are hands down the juiciest ones you’ll ever eat 👏🏻

📌RECIPE BELOW - 8 lamb chops - serves 2-3

Gather 
8 lamb chops 

For the marinade 
50ml extra virgin Greek olive oil 
1 lemon, juiced 
3 garlic cloves, grated 
2 tbsp dried oregano 
1 tsp dried thyme 
1 1/2 tsp pink Himalayan sea salt 
1/2 tsp ground black pepper 

Method 
1.) Prepare the marinade by mixing all the ingredients together in a jug. 
2.) In a large mixing bowl, place the lamb chops and coat them in the marinade. Mix to combine well and cover and refrigerate for at least two hours to let the flavours marinate. 
3.) Let the lamb rest out of the fridge for 20-30 minutes, depending on how warm your kitchen is. This process allows the lamb to develop a crispy edge. 
4.) Heat up a griddle pan over a medium to high heat. After 3-4 minutes, place each lamb chop, leaving a little gap between each one. Cook for 4 minutes on both sides, and 30 seconds on the fat side down. 
5.) Place the cooked lamb chops on a plate and leave to rest for at least 5 minutes. Meanwhile, pour the raw marinade into a saucepan with a few splashes of water.  Let it bubble briskly for 3-4 minutes on a high heat, stirring, until it’s simmered well throughout. This cooks off any bacteria that may have come from the raw lamb. 
6.) Pour the cooked sauce over the lamb chops and serve with a wedge of lemon. I recommend serving with tzatziki and a potato salad. 

#lamb #easyrecipe #greekfood
author: Marina Lydia Georgallides
transcript: If you're not making lamb chops like this, then I seriously don't know what you're doing. Welcome back to another episode of Eat Like a Greek. And today, I'm sharing my recipe for bybagia, aka the juiciest lamb chops you'll ever eat. It all starts off with the most simple but delectable marinade of olive oil, always extra slutty. Not one, not two, but three garlic cloves. And the rest of the ingredients you find listed in the caption. Let the chops marinate for at least two hours in the fridge, then rest them for 20 minutes before cooking on medium to high heat for four minutes on both sides. Always serve with a wedge of lemon, and make sure you follow along for more easy Greek recipes.
title: Greek Lamb Chops (Paidakia) Recipe
one_liner: Juicy Greek-style grilled lamb chops marinated in olive oil, lemon, garlic, and oregano.
key_points: Marinate lamb chops in olive oil, lemon, garlic, oregano, thyme, salt, and pepper for at least 2 hours
Rest chops out of the fridge 20–30 minutes before cooking for a crispier edge
Griddle on medium-high heat for 4 minutes each side, plus 30 seconds fat-side down
Boil the used marinade with water for 3–4 minutes to cook off bacteria, then pour over chops to serve

instructions: 1. Mix olive oil, lemon juice, grated garlic, oregano, thyme, salt, and pepper together in a jug to make the marinade.
2. Coat lamb chops in the marinade, cover, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
3. Remove chops from fridge and rest at room temperature for 20–30 minutes.
4. Heat a griddle pan over medium-high heat for 3–4 minutes, then cook chops 4 minutes per side and 30 seconds fat-side down.
5. Rest cooked chops on a plate for at least 5 minutes.
6. Pour raw marinade into a saucepan with a splash of water and boil briskly for 3–4 minutes, then pour over chops and serve with lemon wedge, tzatziki, and potato salad.
